parsed.explanation: The quoted sentence is the only purported induction step for the universal lower bound. It does not define the parity-row invariant precisely or prove that it survives arbitrary split heights; cuts may pass through the mental d-strips, so the existence of one whole uncancelled odd strip does not follow from the stated alternative. Section 3 only invokes lemma (ii), and the tracking claims or reference to an external file do not supply an argument in this text. A full lower-bound lemma (such as the tree/component signed-sum argument or a rigorous even-position induction) is needed.
